resources.string: Could not refresh the backup list. You can try again.
A private recovery copy will be saved on this phone before updating FinAI data in the same workbook. Personal sheets and columns will be preserved. No additional workbook will be created in Drive.
This phone will sync the workbook. The other phone will stop syncing. Restore your data on this phone and stop synchronization on the previous phone before continuing.
Another phone syncs this workbook. You can transfer synchronization in Advanced options.
This workbook uses a structure this version of FinAI cannot update. Its data has been preserved.
Some rows or columns cannot be identified safely. Review the workbook before syncing again.
The safety copy could not be verified. The workbook has not been rebuilt.
Connect the Google account and workbook associated with the pending changes. Your records remain saved in FinAI.
Sheets is currently unavailable. Changes remain pending and will be retried.
Could not sync Sheets. Your data remains saved in FinAI. Check permissions and try again.
Checking whether Google created the workbook. Sync again; another workbook will not be created while this is being confirmed.
The linked workbook cannot be opened. Check its access in Drive; another workbook will not be created automatically.
The linked workbook is in Drive trash. Restore it to sync with the same workbook. Your data remains saved in FinAI.
